title: Book Two · Chapter 73: The Warm Rain
story:
Early summer rain arrives during the lunch break. Ronan and Jun are near the covered steps. Their ball rolls out into the open space and stops in a shallow puddle.

“I can get it,” Ronan says.

He takes one step. Water runs off the roof in front of him. He steps back. The water misses his head.

Jun moves his shoe. A little stream crosses the step. It reaches his bag. He lifts the bag onto his knee.

Miss Wu comes to the door. She asks the children to move inside. An adult checks the water near the roof edge. The children stay on the ground. They do not climb or hold things up.

Ronan watches the ball through the open door. It rocks in the puddle. Every large drop gives it a little push.

“Our game is swimming,” Jun says.

“It is winning,” Ronan says. “We cannot catch it.”

Inside, they dry their hands. Mei has a small square game on a piece of paper. She uses three beans for each player. Ronan asks to learn.

“You move one at a time,” she says.

Jun sits opposite him. Ronan moves a bean toward the middle. Jun blocks it. Ronan tries another side, but Jun blocks that too.

“You cannot put a bean everywhere,” Ronan says.

“Only where you want to go.”

Mei watches them play. Ronan loses three quick games. Then he asks her to show him one move. She points at the corner. In the next game, he leaves the middle free. He waits at one side.

He loses again. But this game lasts much longer. Jun puts his hands above the board and gives a very small cheer. Ronan catches one of the hands and pushes it down, laughing.

By the end of lunch, the rain is lighter. Miss Wu lets them collect the ball from the edge of the open space. Ronan uses his shoe to roll it onto the covered step. Jun brings a cloth.

The whole ball is wet. They cannot use it today. They leave it in the agreed dry place with their names beside it.

After lessons, Ronan checks the cloth. Water has made a round dark patch under the ball. He changes the cloth. They can play tomorrow.

Outside the school gate, Dad waits with an umbrella. Ronan tells him about the bean game on the way home. Dad says he knows a move. At supper, they use three small buttons instead of beans. Ronan asks Dad to show his move.

## 词句提示

rain＝雨；roof＝屋顶；puddle＝水洼。

## 理解问题

1. 下雨时谁负责屋顶和高处？
2. 孩子们怎样保住自己的游戏？

## 读句子

**Jun / moves / his shoe.** Jun／挪动／他的鞋。
